admission_rule: At least five distinct compatible scored NFL season-week blocks for the exact new primary product/procedure, plus existing scientific/source/operational rules. Use all compatible weeks including losses; preserve conditional evidence and native/fallback contribution. No universal new future-week, nine-week, all-category or 80/90-percent gate.
boundary_note: Use the original floating-point function and frozen policy. The examples introduce no epsilon, rounding or revised margin rule.

current_repository_artifact_state.scope: Pinned repository bytes, not a new served-byte/browser check.

owners.B: Scoped independent checks of the same permitted records and actual delivered output.
owners.C: Data-local executor of the finite retained C-output policy projection using the admitted website contract and existing canonical grading framework.
owners.website: Accountable for consumer policy, complete selector replay, source/catalog admission, release and served verification.

per_query_batch_inputs.availability: Keep full admitted board and each arm available/excluded ordinals. Select before checking gradability; retain technical unavailability, abstention, fallback, push/void and selected unknown separately.
manifest: actual retained decision/as_of clock or explicit unknown
candidate exact method/output/policy IDs and saved bytes
previous frozen selection and persistence receipt, or explicit absence
outcome version separate from forecast generation
timing/evidence tier and declared reconstruction assumptions
per_query_batch_inputs.selected_rows: Reuse tools/weekly_adaptive_overlay.py::PUBLIC_FIELDS and PRODUCTS for the recommendation replay. The appearance-conditioned numerical feed uses its separate closed expiring wire and is not inserted here automatically.
per_query_batch_inputs.status: Checklist for existing formats, not a replacement runtime schema or permission to publish protected rows.
per_query_batch_inputs.unsupported_fields: Do not invent eligibility, prior selections, quote timestamps, schedule, law, native attribution, source completeness, outcomes or zeros.

Over_only_law.decision: SHADOW; selective own-Over accuracy is not website-policy superiority.
Over_only_law.rule: Use exact retained candidate law, threshold, eligibility, abstention and fallback. Do not infer probabilities from a mean or choose a new favorable cutoff.

Top_Picks.restriction: This handoff freezes no new M3-law or passing-TD mapping. Changed forecast inputs require the complete mapping/policy comparison.

numerical_display.decision: KEEP_INCUMBENT_PRIMARY; M3 SHADOW pending actual qualified feed and numerical admission.
numerical_display.restriction: A mean feed supplies no arbitrary-line law and changes no recommendation, probability or Top Picks input.

ordinary_margin.decision: KEEP_INCUMBENT; exact candidate margin-policy comparison and current delivery remain required.
ordinary_margin.precedence: Retained DraftKings close first, then Sleeper Picks; internal estimates do not create book-line leans. Unknown quote clocks stay unknown.
ordinary_margin.rule: Over iff effective_point - line > lean; Under iff difference < -lean; otherwise abstain.

probability_confidence.rule: Require the exact probability product and reliability evidence. A gap or historical hit rate is neither per-pick confidence nor EV.

strict_direction.decision: KEEP_INCUMBENT_RECOMMENDATION_POLICY; retain saved exact-direction evidence separately.
strict_direction.point_rule: Over iff point > line, Under iff point < line; equality abstains. Probability-law decisions retain their separately frozen exact rule.

publication_safety: Permitted source-code metadata and scientific aggregates only; no protected rows, weights, private locators or invented source clocks.

ranking_execution.capacity: At most 12 per side; one best category per player per side. Do not force capacity; one player can appear once on each side.
ranking_execution.effective_value: Valid unexpired selected row first; otherwise finite saved baseline adj with CURRENT_BASELINE/R0_FALLBACK attribution; otherwise unavailable.
ranking_execution.expiry: effective() rejects selected rows at or after valid_until_utc. Exclude frozen selected rows whose expiry precedes kickoff. Consumer validates selected row/expiry; invalid ranking artifacts fall back to saved board.picks.
ranking_execution.gates: Use eligible(), actual policy_for(board), valid integer over/n counters, minimum line, inclusive effective-value/line ratio, strict category lean and inclusive minimum absolute score.
ranking_execution.legacy_distinction: pull/build.py::pick_candidates/build_picks tests raw proj/line, rounds score to two decimals and uses stable input-order ties. Do not substitute it for the typed writer or claim parity without the path-specific retained check.
ranking_execution.persistence: Fresh selections and their durable persistence must precede kickoff. Preserve original row and receipt proofs for frozen started-game choices.
ranking_execution.refresh: Retain authenticated originally persisted started-game choices and occupied slots, then fill remaining capacity only from unstarted games. Preserve the real batch schedule; no fixed weekly list using later information.

ranking_policy.fallback: same-opportunity reference identified by forecast_source and model_version; unavailable is never zero
ranking_policy.meaning: descriptive scaled forecast gap, not win probability or EV

remaining_dependencies.action: Reopen retained bytes and perform/admit only the finite compatible saved-output policy projection; mark inaccessible cells precisely.
remaining_dependencies.item: Exact retained law/point bodies, ordinals and batch eligibility for reception/pass-TD policies not already covered by completed evidence.

remaining_dependencies.action: Reuse exact-compatible replays; otherwise pin the precise mapping/batches before the narrow replay. Verify real preissue registration and immutable delivery, then decide the exact product.
remaining_dependencies.item: Full compatible boards for any changed complete mapping and real current typed source/model/query/feed package.

remaining_dependencies.action: Check the same records without repeating completed masks, mean grades or private fits.
remaining_dependencies.item: New exact policy/output independent checks within permitted scope.

replay_handoff.before_new_grades: Bind exact candidate recipe/output/policy, callable hashes, full batch board, timing tier, identity-mask/exclusion commitments, fallback and earlier frozen selection receipts. A changed mapping is a separate exposed retrospective policy.
replay_handoff.comparisons: Report full-system board availability, named same-case comparisons, each selector own lists at matched capacity and directions on identical selected cases. Equal denominators are not membership parity.
replay_handoff.complete_selector: Use full compatible cross-category boards and actual prepare() or its retained parity-verified equivalent with schedule, kept slots, ties and duplicate handling. Category-only or previously selected rows are insufficient.
replay_handoff.data_local: C may execute on retained restricted bodies and publish permitted aggregate/membership/source commitments through existing handoffs; website admits the precise scope and B checks permitted records independently.
replay_handoff.grader: Reuse the existing admitted canonical case/outcome framework and qualified outcome version. Production reference: pull/grade.py, statistical-presence-verified-int-v7-20261112. No new scorer or missing-as-zero conversion.
replay_handoff.outputs: Weekly and cumulative own Over/Under/combined W-L/decided/rate; eligible/available/selected/unknown/unavailable/abstention/push/void/fallback; native contribution, games and unique player-games; paired controls and existing uncertainty. Preserve adverse and zero-selection weeks.

retained_evidence.A: New shared-frame comparison is W4-7 only. Preserve separately bound older genuinely compatible five-week qualification without resetting or automatic inheritance. Saved Count A points are not a fresh corrected-mean feed.
retained_evidence.DEN_PIT: Closed unopened with zero fits and forecasts; no packet available for admission. Completed conditioning, expiry and stale-save compatibility remain reusable.
retained_evidence.M3: Masks and named independent mean-point checks remain complete. Preserve separate law/median/fit/source-vintage/interval/complete-selector limits. Six partial receiving blocks are not complete slates or original issuance.
